source.title: Kinetic analysis of reversible solid-gas reactions in films: application to the decomposition of CaCO3 and BaCO3 carbonates
source.journal: Journal of Thermal Analysis and Calorimetry 150, 6801-6810
source.figure: 3, red filled circles only, printed p6806

settings.observation_classification: digitized_experimental_onset_at_finite_heating_rate; not exact equilibrium or raw measurements

digitization.method: Visual selection of filled red marker centers in official raster; open stars excluded. Fixed pixel intervals represent reading resolution only, not experimental uncertainty.

comparison.scope: Compare frozen USGS pure-phase equilibrium temperature against independent film onset observations; report offsets outside pixel-reading ranges without inventing experimental or model error bars.

source_formula_issues: Printed Eq17/18 entropy sign differs from expanding Eq4 with deltaG=deltaH-T deltaS.
Printed Eq23 omits logarithm on A_alpha f(alpha).
Printed Eq26 represents remaining fraction rather than positive decomposition conversion.
Printed conclusion reverses the pressure inequality for forward decomposition; Eq3 and thermodynamics require pCO2<peq.

scope: Independent finite-ramp experimental onset comparison, no thermochemical fitting; pixel intervals are not physical uncertainty.
